notes.title: My new game!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It is been a while since I posted something here... I just wanted to announce that [b]I am working on my second project[/b] - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028210/Forgotten_Fears/]Forgotten Fears[/url]. It is a [b]free-to-play[/b] collection of 5 small horror games. I am planning on releasing it around late Q3 - early Q4. [b]I have already launched the Demo featuring the first level - Forest.[/b] So, if you are interested you could check it out :)

notes.title: Small QOL Update
notes.content: - Added a "win screen" that shows after you survive the night.

notes.title: Small QOL update
notes.content: - Added an option to turn off/on the VHS effect.

notes.title: Minor bugfix for the doors
notes.content: - Fixed collision issues with the doors (now you don't get stuck between the door and stairs on the second floor)

notes.title: Intruders release!
notes.content:
[b]Intruders are finally out now with a 20% discount![/b]

If you encountered any bugs, just start a new discussion on the community page. I will try to fix them as fast as possible. If you didn't like something I would love to hear your opinion, so I can try and change things you didn't like or you think should work differently.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2513130/discussions/


[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] I want to announce that I will release Intruders on [b]October 26[/b]! This is my first game that I've made. At the start, it was a very small project and I didn't know that it would see some future, because after I finished my courses I just wanted to test my skills and after playing around for a bit I managed to implement more and more stuff that I planned. I saw some potential in that game, so I decided to try and fully finish this project, though I am very limited with budget and time because I'm just 18 years old student.

[b]I am looking forward to any criticism about the game. Your feedback is very important to me as it helps to understand what I can improve.[/b] My second project will probably take much more time to make as I want to improve everything I've already learned. 

Thanks to everyone, will see you on release :)

notes.title: Demo is here!
notes.content: Hello everyone again! I'm glad to announce that The demo version is finally out. [b]Feel free to comment about everything you didn't like or any bugs[/b]. I will try to fix things as quickly as possible.
